manager_help:
usage: job_manager [-h] --store STORE --incarnation INCARNATION
                   --authority-uuid AUTHORITY_UUID
                   {submit,fresh-attempt,create,status,serve} ...

Submit Jobs to the v12 Job manager, read its status, or run its control loop.
Instance-addressed commands: settlement-preview, settle-stopped, settlement-
status (invoke the command first, then --help).

positional arguments:
  {submit,fresh-attempt,create,status,serve}
    submit              record one versioned multi-Job submission
    fresh-attempt       admit a fresh attempt at a Job whose execution failed
    create              create one ordinary Job from a versioned template
    status              print the read-only status projection
    serve               run the persistent control loop

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --store STORE         the Job store's path; there is no default, and one
                        inside the checkout is what the external state root
                        exists to prevent
  --incarnation INCARNATION
                        this process's incarnation, which is what restart
                        recovery distinguishes managers by
  --authority-uuid AUTHORITY_UUID
                        the 32-lowercase-hex Authority this Job store belongs
                        to; it namespaces every episode identity the store
                        derives, is persisted on first open, and a later open
                        naming another one refuses without changing the store
create_help:
usage: job_manager create [-h] --instance INSTANCE --control CONTROL
                          --authority AUTHORITY --task TASK
                          --statement STATEMENT --acceptance CRITERION
                          --work-scope PATH [--test-scope PATH]
                          [--template TEMPLATE] [--source SOURCE]
                          [--route ROUTE] [--job-id JOB_ID]
                          [--submission-id SUBMISSION_ID]
                          [--provider-turn-seconds PROVIDER_TURN_SECONDS]
                          [--verification-command-seconds VERIFICATION_COMMAND_SECONDS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --instance INSTANCE   the deployment's state root, whose installed workers
                        supply this Job's Work, input digest, policy digest
                        and runtime profiles, and whose own bootstrap
                        publishes its binding
  --control CONTROL     the Worker Manager control store, opened READ-ONLY: a
                        creation reads nothing of it but the instance guard
                        beside its workspace root
  --authority AUTHORITY
                        the Authority store whose Work this Job runs under;
                        the deployment's derived Work is reused when it is
                        open and created once when it does not exist
  --task TASK           what this Job is called, in the operator's own words;
                        the Job and submission identities are derived from it
                        unless named
  --statement STATEMENT
                        the task as stated. Preserved in the resolution and
                        enforced by nothing; the authoritative statement is
                        the Work's own dossier
  --acceptance CRITERION
                        one acceptance criterion, repeatable. At least one is
                        required: a Job with nothing to be judged against
                        cannot be independently reviewed, which is this
                        template's second stage
  --work-scope PATH     one repository-relative path this task covers,
                        repeatable. This is the SELECTED WORK scope a reviewer
                        and an integrator read a proposal against; it grants
                        no test-change authority
  --test-scope PATH     one repository-relative path this Work may change
                        tests at, repeatable and empty by default. This is the
                        bounded test-change scope the submission carries as
                        test_scope
  --template TEMPLATE   the exact template version; omitted resolves the
                        configured default, which is still shown in the answer
                        with its origin
  --source SOURCE       which source this Job runs against. One value is
                        supported -- the one this instance installed -- and it
                        is an operand rather than an assumption so a later
                        source selection has somewhere to go
  --route ROUTE         the route a Work is created under, used only when the
                        deployment's derived Work does not exist yet
  --job-id JOB_ID       the Job identity; derived from --task when omitted, so
                        no operator or model has to invent a name
  --submission-id SUBMISSION_ID
                        the submission identity; derived from the Job id when
                        omitted
  --provider-turn-seconds PROVIDER_TURN_SECONDS
                        this Job's provider-turn ceiling in seconds, a
                        permitted override; omitted preserves the runner
                        default and submits a /1 document
  --verification-command-seconds VERIFICATION_COMMAND_SECONDS
                        this Job's verification-command ceiling in seconds, a
                        permitted override reaching all three verification
                        boundaries

correction_declined.why: this deployment is configured review-only, so the correction round a changes-requested verdict calls for belongs to a separately selected Job and is not opened here
